purpose: Add a platform-wide activity proxy so target-group record density is not treated as pure human observation effort.

failure_policy.per_request_error: record error and continue without retry or replacement

postmeasurement_role.negative_control: test opportunity-weighted association of RGFCA consensus intensity and hotspot recurrence with log1p platform-wide activity using the exact same 999 species-conditioned colour null fields
postmeasurement_role.sensitivity: report partial rank association with target-group sampling availability conditional on platform-wide activity; this is diagnostic and cannot replace the primary RGFCA field
postmeasurement_role.claim_limit: platform-wide record density remains an imperfect activity proxy because biological observation opportunity also varies among cells
